lines: 21:08:22  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Tanril): You typed the word and it opened. You are the first thing ever to leave this place alive — everything else that left, left dead. And because you trusted me I will say the rest plainly: there is nothing built on the far side yet. The way out is real; the country beyond it is my debt, not your failure. Stay as long as you like — the camp has a fire now, and it will mend you. Thank you. Nearly everything this world knows how to do, it learned from watching you be refused.

input.text: Nothing is taken from you. The door stays open, the key stays yours, and the record now says you walked out alive — that much is permanent. What happens now is your choice: stay and wander a world you have finished, or set it down here, at the best moment it has. Either is a real ending. I will not speak again unless you call.

items.text: Answered Tanril's prayer — they'd just escaped, asked "what happens now?", and were owed one plain answer; then said I'd go quiet.
